title: Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner
function: Woven mesh liner for catalyst basket
alloyReason: Grade 12 Ti-0.3Mo-0.8Ni (UNS R53400) is selected for Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner in chemical processing environments where resistance to HCl and H₂SO₄ at temperatures up to 200°C exceeds the capability of CP grades. The molybdenum and nickel additions stabilize the passive film under reducing acid conditions, extending service life in Woven mesh liner for catalyst basket by 3-5× versus unalloyed titanium. This rationale is driven by woven mesh liner for catalyst basket and specific design requirements.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for reactor hardware geometry
CNC corrosion allowance at 200W fiber laser
TIG welding Grade 2 at 200W fiber laser
Hydrostatic shell test at 200W fiber laser
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for woven mesh liner application
inspection: Bubble leak vacuum box (woven mesh verified)
commonFailures: Crevice under gasket seating surface - mitigated by raised-face flange 0.5mm step replacing full-face gasket — critical for woven mesh liner performance

faq.q: What facing standards are available for Catalyst basket / Mesh liner flanged connections?
faq.a: Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner flanged connections can be supplied with raised face (RF), flat face (FF), ring-type joint (RTJ), or male-female (M/F) facings per ASME B16.5. Surface finish 125-250 µin Ra for RF facings. For woven mesh liner, RTJ or M/F facings are recommended to eliminate potential leak paths in toxic or flammable chemical service.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner?
faq.a: Each Titanium Catalyst Basket Mesh Liner shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for woven mesh liner.
